title: Add local, moving, and stage lighting
summary: Place local lights, aim spotlights, preview sweeps, and override sunlight in Stage volumes.
outcome: Lighting sources and volumes ready for a lighting build.

sections.title: Place and aim a local light

steps.title: Add light
steps.text: Choose Entity → Add light or create light from Gameplay entities, then place it and select it in the Entities inspector.

steps.title: Set shape
steps.text: Adjust color, Radius, and Intensity. For a spotlight, expand Target & cone, choose Create aim target, move the target to aim, and set outer and inner FOV plus a whole-number Cone exponent (0–255); keep outer FOV below 180 degrees.

steps.title: Choose light flags
steps.text: Expand Definition & flags to inspect the light definition and choose Primary omni or Primary spot. Dynamic shadows lets a Primary spot cast moving-object shadows in game, subject to the game's active shadow-map limit.

steps.title: Apply and inspect
steps.text: Choose Apply light. Use Revert to discard uncommitted field changes; rebuild to incorporate lighting changes into compiled output.

sections.title: Preview a sweep

steps.title: Configure motion
steps.text: Enable Sweep and set Total arc and Seconds each way. Use Play sweep preview to review motion, drag the purple arc ends to adjust range, and Shift-drag left/right to rotate the sweep plane.

tips: Sweep applies the current light values when enabled. Preview shadows remain baked; rebuild to apply changed lighting and game dynamic-shadow flags.

sections.title: Override lighting in a volume

steps.title: Create a Stage
steps.text: Select convex brushes, search for stage in Gameplay entities, and create it. In the Environment inspector, set only the sunlight or Ambient values this volume should override; unchecked values inherit world lighting.

steps.title: Resolve overlaps
steps.text: Reshape or rotate Stage brushes to cover the intended region. Use Earlier stage and Later stage to change priority where Stage volumes overlap.

tips: The first Stage in entity order wins in overlapping regions.
